record.title: Observe stock two-word composition and stop before conversion
record.intent: Test the predicted mask and global store using two explicit synthetic mapped-register responses.
requirements: Disposable guest only; preserve stock APK and native library bytes; no physical instrument access.
Complete at most two guarded read32 accesses at offsets 0x4048 then 0x4044.
Use distinct deterministic words with upper high-word bits set; do not assign physical identity semantics.
Stop the observed thread before the converter call, on any unsupported access, or at a fixed step budget.
Preserve failed attempts and close the stated question even if the expected observation is unavailable.
acceptance: Pin helper, input and output hashes and the explicit two-word fixture.
Validate two-read completion and bounded stepping against a private deterministic control before stock execution.
Preserve existing width and direction controls and add a control that rejects an unexpected second access.
Record real stopped PC, completed response count and global value if the boundary is reached.
Independently verify evidence, stock bytes, stable system_server and guest teardown.
